materials.presentation: Audience: product and engineering colleagues. Goal: explain an evaluation project and agree on the next experiment. We evaluated a classifier on 200 synthetic documents. Error review found ambiguous labels. We propose revising the labeling guide before comparing models. These are fictional example facts, not production results.
materials.article: An evaluation dataset helps a team compare model changes consistently. Each example needs an input, an expected outcome, and a reason for that outcome. Ambiguous examples can make comparisons misleading. A team can review disagreement, clarify the labeling rules, and keep a separate holdout set. Strong offline results alone do not prove that a feature will help users; deployment monitoring remains necessary.
